evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Colaborar com as áreas de negócio para traduzir necessidades funcionais em modelos de dados e especificações técnicas claras
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role builds the modeling layer and data infrastructure consumed broadly by business areas, without a specific commercial, product, or finance emphasis; classified as internal_data.

evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role translates functional needs defined by business areas into technical specifications, reflecting scoped delivery rather than independently set direction; classified as execution.

evidence.testing_framing: Implementar verificações automáticas de qualidade para assegurar a fiabilidade e integridade dos dados
